results.title: CVE-2021-23337: Command Injection in lodash via template function
results.description: The project depends on `lodash` version `4.17.20`. A command injection vulnerability exists in versions prior to 4.17.21 in the `template` function when setting `sourceURL` or injecting untrusted template variables. Source code inspection reveals `src/utils/template-helper.js` imports `lodash` and invokes `_.template()` on external parameters.
results.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Verify dependency in `package-lock.json`: `"lodash": { "version": "4.17.20" }`.
2. Observe import in `src/utils/template-helper.js`: `import _ from 'lodash';` and call `_.template(options.raw)`.
3. Supply crafted template string containing JavaScript expressions executing child process.
results.impact: Attackers can execute arbitrary commands on the host operating system with the privileges of the web application.

cwe.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

results.title: CVE-2023-45857: Server-Side Request Forgery in Axios via follow-redirects
results.description: The application depends on `axios` version `0.21.1` which pulls a vulnerable version of `follow-redirects`. When handling cross-origin HTTP 302 redirects, confidential `Authorization` and `Cookie` headers are unintentionally forwarded to third-party endpoints. In `src/services/api-client.js`, Axios is used to fetch remote webhooks.
results.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Inspect `package.json` confirming `"axios": "^0.21.1"`.
2. Review `src/services/api-client.js` line 52 making authenticated requests using `axios.get(targetUrl, { headers: { Authorization: token } })`.
3. Configure malicious endpoint to return a 302 redirect to an attacker-controlled listener; observe Authorization header forwarded.
results.impact: Leakage of sensitive user and service authentication tokens to untrusted third parties.
